sourceTitle: The Principles of Success in Literature
description: "The Principles of Success in Literature" by George Henry Lewes is a treatise on literary theory written in the mid-19th century. The work explores the foundational elements that contribute to success in writing, focusing on the interplay between literature and social progress, and the attributes that foster literary excellence.
